text: Only triggered abilities and activated abilities put anything on the stack. A triggered ability says "When" or "Whenever" or names a time such as "After combat"; {Alluring} and {Resonant} also work as triggered abilities; an activated ability is written with a colon. A sentence that states a standing fact ("I gain +2/+2", "Spells cost [one] more to play during battle") is a static ability, and a sentence that says "instead", "as" or "if" and names no target is a replacement effect. Neither goes on the stack, except that a replacement whose substitute names a target puts that substitute on the stack.

text: An ability that triggers on a card being played, and then acts on what was played ("negate that effect"), acts on the item that play put on the stack. Another item with the same name and the same controller is not it, whether it is older or newer. A copy of the played spell is not it either, because a copy is not played (see effects.playing.copy-not-played).
